input.quote: (b) Sparkling may terminate this Agreement at any time upon ninety (90) calendar days written notice to Garman. If Sparkling terminates this Agreement pursuant to this Section 17(b), Sparkling shall cease using the Software at the end of the ninety (90) day notice period, and shall certify to Garman within thirty (30) calendar days of termination that Sparkling has destroyed or has returned to Garman all Software, Documentation and Codes.
input.rationale: No exit clause exists anywhere. Section 17 addresses only Sparkling's return/destruction of Garman's Software, Documentation and Codes (p0118) and a fee refund on Garman default (p0128); Section 8 return of Sparkling's Confidential Information applies only if the rejection option is exercised pre-acceptance, not on expiry or termination generally; the escrow clause (Section 16) gives source-code continuity but no transition assistance or data return, and Section 18 survival adds nothing absent an operative exit obligation. We therefore insert a single Section 17(d) at the preferred level: up to six months' transition assistance at then-current rates, return of Sparkling's data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days of expiry or termination, and certified deletion after that return. Survival is already carried by Section 18's general clause, so no collateral edits are needed.

proposal.summary: Insert exit assistance and data return/deletion obligations in Section 17
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The termination section only requires Sparkling to return Garman's Software, Documentation and Codes, with no exit help or return of our own data. We have added a short Section 17(d) giving us up to six months of transition assistance at Garman's then-current rates, return of our data in a machine-readable format within 30 days and certified deletion thereafter; we can fall back to 90 days of assistance with the same 30-day export.

ops.text: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Garman shall (1) at Sparkling's request, provide transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Garman's then-current rates; (2) within thirty (30) calendar days of such expiry or termination, return all of Sparkling's data in a standard machine-readable format; and (3) after such return, delete Sparkling's data from its systems and certify such deletion in writing.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
